Malika Sonnet

Malika Sonnet is a Belgian politician and badminton enthusiast who has been recognized for her contributions to the sport. Born on February 12, 1975, in Brussels, Belgium, Sonnet has been an active member of the Belgian Badminton Federation since 2000. Early Life and Career

Sonnet studied political science at the University of Brussels, where she earned a Bachelor's degree in 1997. She began her political career as a councilor in the municipality of Schaerbeek, serving from 2001 to 2006. In 2007, she was elected to the Belgian Chamber of Representatives, where she has served as a member of the Committee on Sports and Education. Badminton Involvement

Sonnet's involvement in badminton began in the early 2000s, when she joined a local badminton club in Brussels. She quickly became an avid player and advocate for the sport, serving as the president of the Belgian Badminton Federation from 2010 to 2015. In 2012, Sonnet was instrumental in organizing the European Badminton Championships, which were held in Antwerp, Belgium. Her efforts were recognized by the Badminton World Federation, which awarded her the prestigious "Golden Shuttle" award for outstanding contributions to the sport. WikiProject Badminton\/tournament focus list

In 2018, Sonnet was added to the focus list of the Wikimedia project WikiProject Badminton\/tournament focus list, a collaborative effort to improve the coverage of badminton tournaments on Wikipedia. Her inclusion on the list recognizes her expertise and contributions to the sport, as well as her commitment to promoting badminton through online platforms. References
